messages.author: 46f0fec04a5c6039
messages.subject: exporting GBM models as JSON
parts:
Here at eBay we use GBM to train regression models for ranking functions. In order easily  deploy the trained models to  production systems we found useful to write a small script to convert GBM model to JSON and a Scala library to execute the model or to convert it to C++/Java code. 

We open sourced the library at https://github.com/eBay/bonsai, which contains both the R code and the Scala code. 

If other people were to find the functionality useful it would be convenient to integrate the small R scripts that convert the models into JSON  into the main code itself: I picked GPL as the license for the R portion for ease of integration. 

Have a look and let me know if you might be interested.

Alex Cozzi
